title: Showtime

description.en: Native macOS browser for agent-directed product demo recordings
description.zh: 原生 macOS 演示浏览器，由 Agent 编排网页交互并录制产品演示

subject: Initial purple browser/play identity retained as source evidence while the approved classic clapperboard is applied by the Showtime Codex

primary.source: Sources/Showtime/App/StudioView.swift: Theme.accentHex; preserved local source snapshot

ink.source: Sources/Showtime/App/StudioView.swift: Theme.ink, sRGB (0.145, 0.192, 0.149), rounded to 8-bit channels

source.description: Native macOS browser for agent-directed product demo recordings

goal.en: Turn scripted interactions with real webpages into product demo movies on macOS. Agents can direct pointer movement, clicks, typing, camera zoom and animated captions through JSON scripts, a CLI or MCP; the native browser exports MP4 without an audio track.
goal.zh: 把真实网页上的脚本化交互制作成 macOS 产品演示视频。Agent 可通过 JSON 剧本、CLI 或 MCP 编排鼠标移动、点击、输入、镜头缩放和动态字幕，原生浏览器将演示导出为不含音轨的 MP4。

role.en: Native application and typed script execution
role.zh: 原生应用与类型化脚本执行

role.en: macOS studio, inspector and window integration
role.zh: macOS 演播室、检查器与窗口集成
真实网页渲染与浏览器交互
画面合成与 MP4 导出
命令行客户端与 MCP 服务器
声明式演示编排与 Agent 工具

subject.en: Classic black-and-white clapperboard with SHOWTIME lettering, numbered production fields and a brushed-metal hinge
subject.zh: 带 SHOWTIME 字样、场次数字与拉丝金属铰链的经典黑白场记板

description.en: A raised upper stick and broad, mostly frontal slate form one compact object. The complete hinge and corners remain visible, with 178.5 px of clearance against the final rounded outline.
description.zh: 抬起的上板与接近正面的宽阔板面构成紧凑整体，铰链和所有边角保持完整，与最终圆角边界至少相距 178.5 px。

description.en: Matte charcoal, ivory diagonal inlays and brushed silver preserve the classic physical slate. SHOWTIME and ROLL / SCENE / TAKE markings belong to the object; every fully opaque extracted native pixel retains its original RGB.
description.zh: 哑光炭黑、象牙白斜条与拉丝金属保留经典实物质感，SHOWTIME 和 ROLL / SCENE / TAKE 文字印在板面上；提取后所有完全不透明的原生像素均保持原 RGB。

description.en: Sparse film-gate brackets, perforation marks and editing cues sit on pale sage paper. Green stays in the independent background and soft shadows; the small interface mark uses the transparent board.
description.zh: 浅鼠尾草绿纸面搭配稀疏的取景定位线、胶片齿孔和剪辑标记。绿色留在独立底纹与柔和投影里，小尺寸界面标记使用透明场记板。

palette.source: Designed presentation; artwork/logo-family/showtime/2026-09-10-02/presentation.json, finishing 03. Kept separate from native artwork and application theme tokens.
Owner-requested green design anchor used only by the separate background motif at 30% opacity; presentation.json.

sizeNote.en: The title and three production fields read at large sizes. At 32/24/16 px, the lifted striped stick and slate silhouette carry recognition; the small field labels and material grain merge. Sidebar and browser specimens show identity scale; Showtime itself is a native macOS app.
sizeNote.zh: 大尺寸可读片名与三栏场记信息；32/24/16 px 主要依靠抬起的斜条上板和场记板轮廓识别，细小栏名与材质纹理会合并。侧栏和浏览器示例用于检查标记尺寸，Showtime 本身是原生 macOS 应用。
